messages:
Sophie Tran: quick preflight for CedarGrove private cutover. they want 72h notice but were targeting Fri EOD. any outstanding infra asks?
Diego Ramirez: firewall team still needs the exact source/dest pair for peering. cedar IP block: 10.200.0.0/16, our service CIDR: 10.44.0.0/16. they also requested MTU check (jumbo packets cause issues).
Priya Nair: noted MTU. also confirm if theyre using S3 VPC endpoint for audit logs or NAT + proxy. they indicated they prefer endpoint.
Kunal Desai: for IAM mapping: they want us to assume a role in their account with least-privilege. sending minimal trust policy and permission set now.
Diego Ramirez: firewall wants protocol/port list: TCP 443 for API traffic, TCP 1024-65535 for ephemeral? we should limit ephemeral to 10240-32768 per infra guidance.
Priya Nair: KMS: they insist on customer-managed CMK (BYOK). we must provide key alias and a key policy snippet that restricts decrypt to calls coming from the dedicated subnet's VPC endpoint.
Sophie Tran: good. also they flagged a renewal watch item: deploy glitches in staging last month left them uneasy. we need a mitigation plan to present next week.
Kunal Desai: mitigation idea: run a 2-week Dedicated trial on a small GPU cluster, include SLO reports showing p99/99.9 and a playbook for rollback. that usually reduces churn risk.
Diego Ramirez: putting the peering accept command for their ops: ```bash
aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0d9f5b2a
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0f1a2b3c --destination-cidr-block 10.44.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0d9f5b2a
```
Kunal Desai: trust policy (their side should replace OUR_ACCOUNT_ID): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::OUR_ACCOUNT_ID:root"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```
Priya Nair: KMS policy notes: - allow kms:Decrypt for role arn:aws:iam::THEIR_ACCT:role/cedargrove-redwood-access - deny when aws:SourceIp not in 10.200.0.0/16 (or require kms:ViaService condition) - include CloudTrail log selector for KMS events forwarded to their Splunk HEC.
Sophie Tran: Splunk details: HEC tokens will be provided by them. ask: do we need a NAT for Splunk forwarder or can they reach HEC via private link?
Diego Ramirez: they said PrivateLink for Splunk available. we'll need to validate DNS + endpoint policy. if PrivateLink not used, a small NAT + ENI would be fallback.
Kunal Desai: ops-bot: please confirm audit delivery bucket status.
ops-bot: audit-bucket: cedar-audit-prod delivery healthy, last PUT 2024-09-02T18:12:03Z, size 2.3GB, lifecycle=90d.
Sophie Tran: perfect. action items: (1) Diego to send peering & MTU checklist to CedarGrove (2) Kunal to publish IAM role JSON + ARN placeholder (3) Priya to draft KMS key alias + policy and CloudTrail selector (4) Sophie to build renewal mitigation one-pager + Dedicated trial proposal (5) Diego/Priya to capture Splunk PrivateLink validation steps.
Diego Ramirez: I'll schedule a dry-run on Thu 11:00 AM PT with their network + security SWAT team. please add a 20-min block for tracing p99 with live traces.
Priya Nair: I'll prepare a short feedback capture form (3 q's): network clarity / IAM clarity / anything missing. we'll include link in the runbook.
Kunal Desai: one more: request that CedarGrove provide an ops contact + firewall ticket number before cutover. reduces last-minute back-and-forth.
Sophie Tran: agreed. I'll draft the invite and include the feedback form + runbook. thanks everyone. well re-run health check after dry-run and escalate renewal risk if no improvement. :white_check_mark:
